profile.name: Nyx
profile.bio: I’m a software developer from the Chicago area, creating completely open source apps, games and websites for people to use in their daily tasks.

projects.title: Pronouns
projects.description: A pronouns sharing app inspired by pronouns.cc.

projects.title: Progression Mod
projects.description: A progression mod for Minecraft 26.1+ that makes playthroughs more fun.

projects.title: Video Destroyer
projects.description: A simple website that destroys any video you put into it.

projects.title: OptiArk
projects.description: The new repo for building the OptiArk Pack, now using packwiz!

paragraphs: I make random apps and tools for people to sometimes use and add to their minecraft modpacks if their mods, they occasionaly work and I work on them sometimes.
I mostly work with MacOS and Linux things, most recently Linux desktop enviroments and MacOS apps written in Swift as I've been learning that as my new coding language that I know.
You can go and fork any of my projects on Github, just give credit somewhere in your projects and please actualy change somthing in your forks instead of forking them and doing nothing with it.

facts.headline: Open source by default
facts.supporting: Every app I make is open source, you can see the code and fork it.
